scope: Exploratory adaptive-operator and larger-grid diagnostic; not primary inference
protocol: Same generated instances and initial priority ordering per scale/seed; 5-iteration random-repair baseline versus 8-iteration adaptive or conflict-only repair. This is not a compute-matched comparison.
interpretation: The pilot found no complete-routing advantage for the adaptive multi-operator method over the random-repair baseline at either larger scale. The xlarge run cost more time. Five seeds per scale are too few for confirmatory inference; the separate 15-seed matched-density scale study remains the stronger scaling evidence.
